description: This PHP class 'Today' implements an interpreter for a predefined filter named 'Today' within the SuiteCRM JSON API filtering framework. It provides methods to check if a filter name matches 'Today' and to generate a date-based filter string representing the start of the current day.

classes.name: Today
classes.description: Interpreter class for the 'Today' predefined filter, returning a date constraint for today's start.

methods.name: hasByPreMadeFilter
methods.description: Checks if the provided filter name matches 'Today'.

methods.name: getByPreMadeFilter
methods.description: Returns a filter string representing the start of the current day in ISO 8601 format.
